evidence.note: Refrigerator's upper fresh-food door is fully closed.
User's hand is on the door edge and the door has begun separating from the frame.
Fresh-food door is fully open and illuminated interior is visible.
User grasps the open refrigerator door to close it.
Refrigerator door is closed and interior is no longer visible.

events.object_description: Upper fresh-food door of the stainless-steel refrigerator

evidence.note: Both wood-grain cabinet doors above the cooktop appear closed.
The left door of the cabinet above the range hood has opened, exposing the cabinet interior.
User reaches toward the open left door to close it.
The cabinet fronts are closed again.

events.object_description: Left hinged door of the wood-grain cabinet above the cooktop/range hood

evidence.note: Right door of the cabinet above the range hood still appears closed while the other door is open.
User's hand is manipulating the second cabinet door as it swings outward.
Both cabinet doors are visibly open, including the right hinged door.
Both cabinet doors are still open immediately before closure.
Both doors are closed; the exact ordering of the two closures is not sampled.

events.object_description: Right hinged door of the wood-grain cabinet above the cooktop/range hood

evidence.note: Top drawer to the right of the oven is closed and the user reaches for its handle.
Top drawer has been pulled open, revealing utensils and kitchen items.
User pushes the still-open drawer inward.

events.object_description: Top utensil drawer immediately to the right of the oven

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. 'On' denotes open and 'off' denotes closed. The two upper-cabinet doors are reported separately because they are distinct hinged parts, although their closure occurs within the same 8-frame sampling interval.
scene_description: A user moves through a compact kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator door, two separate upper-cabinet doors above the cooktop, and a utensil drawer beside the oven.
